CONGRESS_US = {

	USA_tax_break = {
		icon = passlaw
		ai_will_do = { factor = 10 }
		available = {
			NOT = {
				has_idea = tax_break
			}
		}
		visible = {
			NOT = {
				has_idea = tax_break
			} 
		}
		cost = 25
		days_remove = 30
		days_re_enable = 180

		remove_effect = {
			add_timed_idea = {
			days = 180
			idea = tax_break
		}
		}
	}

	The_Admission_of_Alaska_and_Hawaii = {
	
		allowed = { tag = USA }
		ai_will_do = { factor = 10 }
		
		available = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = law_passing }
		}
		visible = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = law_passing }
		   has_country_flag = Admission_of_Alaska_and_Hawaii_vote
		}
		cost = 50
		fire_only_once = yes
		
		complete_effect = {
			set_variable = {					
				bipartisan_value = 0.55
			}	
			set_country_flag = law_passing
			set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:The_Admission_of_Alaska_and_Hawaii }
			bipartisan_house_calc = yes
			#custom_effect_tooltip = will_vote
			
			hidden_effect = {
				senate_normal_dem_support = yes
				senate_dixiecrat_dem_support = yes
				senate_gop_total_support = yes
			}
			
			effect_tooltip = {
				add_ideas = usa_statehood_expansion
				add_political_power = 30
				463 = { add_core_of = USA }
				629 = { add_core_of = USA }

			} 			
			hidden_effect = { USA_begin_congress_vote = { BILL = token:The_Admission_of_Alaska_and_Hawaii HOUSE = 217 SENATE = senate_passing_value DYNAMIC = 1 SHORT = token:USA_CONGRESS_SHORT_The_Admission_of_Alaska_and_Hawaii } }
		}
		days_remove = 50
		remove_effect = {
			hidden_effect = { USA_record_congress_vote = { BILL = token:The_Admission_of_Alaska_and_Hawaii HOUSE = 217 SENATE = senate_passing_value DYNAMIC = 1 SHORT = token:USA_CONGRESS_SHORT_The_Admission_of_Alaska_and_Hawaii } }
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = { 
						check_variable = { supseat > 216 } 
						check_variable = { supseat_sen > senate_passing_value } 
					}
					country_event = { id = us_congress.100 }
					add_ideas = usa_statehood_expansion
					add_political_power = 30
					463 = { add_core_of = USA }
					629 = { add_core_of = USA }
					set_country_flag = ak_hi_state
					add_to_variable = { 
						US_SENATE = 2
					}
					add_to_variable = { 
						senate_passing_value = 2
					}
					add_to_variable = { 
						senate_failing_value = 2
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { supseat < 217 } 
							check_variable = { supseat_sen < senate_failing_value  } 
						}
					}
					country_event = { id = parliament.1 }
				}
				set_variable = { supseat = 0 }
				set_variable = { supseat_sen = 0 }
				
				clr_country_flag = law_passing
				clear_support_types = yes
			}
		}
	}

		icon = generic_industry

	
		allowed = { tag = USA }

		available = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = law_passing }
		}

		}
